checks.message: Cam Sync After RPM must be 0 while Trigger Pattern is Nissan SR. It gates the cam handler off until the ECU already has an RPM reading, and this pattern has no crank-only sync to produce one, so the engine would never sync.

Cam Sync After RPM must be 0 while Trigger Pattern is Nissan SR. It gates the cam handler off until the ECU already has an RPM reading, and this pattern has no crank-only sync to produce one, so the engine would never sync.

[Driver 8192] is set to Fully Seq, but the Nissan SR pattern resolves engine position to 180 crank degrees only. The firmware syncs on the cam window pitch and does not measure their widths, so the ECU knows it is on a 180 degree boundary but not which one, and the phase is re-thrown on every sync acquisition.

That is enough for distributor ignition and paired or batch injection. A mode that needs the 0 against 360 degree distinction will run a cycle out of phase about half the time it syncs.

Set it anyway?
Default IAT value needs to be between 0 and 0.

checks.message:
[Driver 8223] is set to Wasted Spark, but the Nissan SR pattern resolves engine position to 180 crank degrees only. The firmware syncs on the cam window pitch and does not measure their widths, so the ECU knows it is on a 180 degree boundary but not which one, and the phase is re-thrown on every sync acquisition.

That is enough for distributor ignition and paired or batch injection. A mode that needs the 0 against 360 degree distinction will run a cycle out of phase about half the time it syncs.

Set it anyway?
Extra value needs to be between 10 and 255.

Cam Sync After RPM must be 0 while Trigger Pattern is Nissan SR. It gates the cam handler off until the ECU already has an RPM reading, and this pattern has no crank-only sync to produce one, so the engine would never sync.
Extra value needs to be between 10 and 255.
Extra value needs to be between 10 and 255.

Trigger Pattern and Cam A Pattern have to be set to Nissan SR together - the crank track alone carries no position information, so the ECU never reaches sync on any other combination.

Set this one now and the other one next?

checks.message: Cam Sync After RPM must be 0 while Trigger Pattern is Nissan SR. It gates the cam handler off until the ECU already has an RPM reading, and this pattern has no crank-only sync to produce one, so the engine would never sync.
Cam A Pattern value needs to be between 0 and 0.
Default IAT value needs to be between 0 and 0.

[Driver 8223] is set to Wasted Spark, but the Nissan SR pattern resolves engine position to 180 crank degrees only. The firmware syncs on the cam window pitch and does not measure their widths, so the ECU knows it is on a 180 degree boundary but not which one, and the phase is re-thrown on every sync acquisition.

That is enough for distributor ignition and paired or batch injection. A mode that needs the 0 against 360 degree distinction will run a cycle out of phase about half the time it syncs.

Set it anyway?
Default IAT value needs to be between 0 and 0.

[Driver 8192] is set to Fully Seq, but the Nissan SR pattern resolves engine position to 180 crank degrees only. The firmware syncs on the cam window pitch and does not measure their widths, so the ECU knows it is on a 180 degree boundary but not which one, and the phase is re-thrown on every sync acquisition.

That is enough for distributor ignition and paired or batch injection. A mode that needs the 0 against 360 degree distinction will run a cycle out of phase about half the time it syncs.

Set it anyway?
